Hanuman.visual_key: muscular humanoid vanara (monkey warrior), golden metallic helmet with a pointed top, golden armlets, bright orange-brown skin texture, curly shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a red and yellow silk loincloth (dhoti) with a golden waistband. Tail behaves dynamically as his partner.
Hanuman.physicality: Exudes massive physical weight and explosive power. Ground steps are heavy and deep. Works in tandem with his Tail as a close buddy, sharing glances and silent team coordination.

The_Tail_Vaalagaathram.visual_key: Hanuman's long, expressive, sentient monkey tail. Features a shiny silver ring piercing near the middle with a small bronze bell hanging from it. The tip of the tail is thick and furry (like a paint brush). Expression lives in the fur tip: angry = fur clinches tightly; happy/excited = fur spreads wide and fluffy; sad/defeated = fur slumps flat and limp.
The_Tail_Vaalagaathram.physicality: Independently expressive and sentient, behaving like the Magic Carpet from Aladdin. It uncoils, sweeps, points, and wraps around items to support Hanuman. Makes rustling, sweeping, and soft squeaking noises. Ring bell tinkles softly during movements.

Lord_Rama.visual_key: royal blue-skinned prince, tall and slender, hair bound in an elegant jatamakuta topknot, wearing a yellow silk dhoti, carrying a massive wooden bow (Kodanda) and a golden arrow quiver.
Lord_Rama.physicality: Symmetrical, regal, and calm. Moves with frictionless grace, completely grounded by gravity.

Lakshmana.visual_key: fair golden-complexioned prince, green tunic, yellow dhoti, hair in a jatamakuta topknot, holding a long bow.
Lakshmana.physicality: Coiled, protective, and defensive. Stances are wider and alert.

Sita.visual_key: graceful woman with dark cascading hair, tearful brown eyes, wearing a simple pale yellow saree with modest golden borders, no jewelry.
Sita.physicality: Slumped, exhausted posture, leaning heavily on pillars to show severe physical and emotional grief.

Ravana.visual_key: ten-headed demon king, massive crown, heavy dark plate armor, seated on a throne carved of white bone.
Ravana.physicality: Immovable, arrogant, gesturing with slow, cruel authority.

Indrajit.visual_key: dark-skinned demon prince, spiked golden crown, mustache, bronze chest plate with spiral engravings, crimson dhoti, curved scimitar sword.
Indrajit.physicality: Arrogant and flying/hovering dynamically in clouds.

Kumbhakarna.visual_key: colossal, dark-skinned giant demon with wild hair, wearing heavy grey-and-red plate armor, wielding a massive golden mace (Gada).
Kumbhakarna.physicality: Tectonic weight. Each step shakes the frame. Swings with crushing downward force.

Vibhishana.visual_key: demonic prince with a noble mustache, wearing a deep green armor tunic, gold armlets, and a golden quiver.
Vibhishana.physicality: Stands tall, placing comforting hands on allies, embodying a bridge between Lanka and Rama.

Sugriva.visual_key: monkey king, golden fur, yellow tunic, gold crown, weeping with visible tears.
Sugriva.physicality: Emotional, expressive, slumped shoulders in grief.

Jambavan.visual_key: wise giant bear-king, thick dark blue-grey fur, golden crown and necklace with a circular pendant, red waist sash.
Jambavan.physicality: Massive bulk, slow deliberate gestures, pointing with a heavy paw.
